title: Improving support with every interaction at OpenAI
summary: Learn how OpenAI uses AI to enhance support, cutting response times, improving quality, and scaling to meet hypergrowth.
body: Learn how OpenAI uses AI to enhance support, cutting response times, improving quality, and scaling to meet hypergrowth.
summaryZh: OpenAI分享了如何通过集成AI技术来优化客户支持流程，在面对业务爆发式增长时，实现缩短响应时间、提升服务质量并保持高可扩展性。原始信息显示：Learn how OpenAI uses AI to enhance support, cutting response times, improving quality, and scaling to meet hypergrowth.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Improving support with every interaction at OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：介绍了OpenAI如何利用AI提升客户支持质量与响应速度，是企业大模型应用落地的具体实例。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
